views.name: v_accuracy_by_region
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_accuracy_by_region AS
        SELECT
            region,
            COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT link_id) AS matched_links,
            ROUND(AVG(observed_aadt), 2) AS average_observed_aadt,
            ROUND(AVG(forecast_aadt), 2) AS average_forecast_aadt,
            ROUND(AVG(error_adt), 2) AS bias_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(abs_error_adt), 2) AS mae_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(abs_pct_error), 2) AS mape_percent
        FROM model_accuracy_samples
        GROUP BY region
        ORDER BY sample_count DESC

views.name: v_accuracy_by_road_class
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_accuracy_by_road_class AS
        SELECT
            road_class,
            COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT link_id) AS matched_links,
            ROUND(AVG(observed_aadt), 2) AS average_observed_aadt,
            ROUND(AVG(forecast_aadt), 2) AS average_forecast_aadt,
            ROUND(AVG(error_adt), 2) AS bias_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(abs_error_adt), 2) AS mae_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(abs_pct_error), 2) AS mape_percent
        FROM model_accuracy_samples
        GROUP BY road_class
        ORDER BY sample_count DESC

            ROUND(AVG(abs_error_adt), 2) AS mae_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(abs_pct_error), 2) AS mape_percent
        FROM model_accuracy_samples
        GROUP BY source_table
        ORDER BY sample_count DESC

views.name: v_accuracy_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_accuracy_summary AS
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT link_id) AS matched_links,

            ROUND(AVG(observed_aadt), 2) AS average_observed_aadt,
            ROUND(AVG(forecast_aadt), 2) AS average_forecast_aadt,

views.name: v_annual_collection_link_coverage
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_annual_collection_link_coverage AS
        SELECT
            c.link_id,
            r.road_no,
            r.link_name,
            r.region,
            r.road_class,
            r.surface_type,
            c.structured_file_count,
            c.traffic_file_count,
            c.origin_destination_file_count,
            c.latest_year,
            c.year_span,
            c.total_size_mb,
            c.data_score,
            c.source_years_json,
            c.sample_files_json
        FROM annual_collection_link_coverage c
        LEFT JOIN road_links r ON r.link_id = c.link_id
        ORDER BY c.data_score DESC, c.structured_file_count DESC

views.name: v_class_yearly_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_class_yearly_summary AS
        SELECT
            r.road_class,
            f.year,
            COUNT(*) AS link_count,
            ROUND(SUM(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS total_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS average_adt,
            ROUND(SUM(r.length_km), 2) AS length_km
        FROM road_links r
        JOIN traffic_forecasts f ON f.link_id = r.link_id
        GROUP BY r.road_class, f.year

views.name: v_network_register_quality
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_network_register_quality AS
        SELECT
            COUNT(n.link_id) AS register_links,
            SUM(CASE WHEN r.link_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_map_links,
            SUM(CASE WHEN r.link_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS register_only_links,
            ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.link_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / CASE WHEN COUNT(n.link_id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(n.link_id) END, 2) AS matched_percent,
            ROUND(SUM(n.length_km), 3) AS register_length_km,
            COUNT(DISTINCT n.maintenance_region) AS register_regions,
            COUNT(DISTINCT n.road_class) AS register_road_classes,
            COUNT(DISTINCT n.surface_type) AS register_surfaces
        FROM network_register_2026 n
        LEFT JOIN road_links r ON r.link_id = n.link_id

views.name: v_network_yearly_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_network_yearly_summary AS
        SELECT
            year,
            COUNT(*) AS link_count,
            ROUND(SUM(forecast_adt), 2) AS total_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(forecast_adt), 2) AS average_adt,
            ROUND(MIN(forecast_adt), 2) AS minimum_adt,
            ROUND(MAX(forecast_adt), 2) AS maximum_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(density_adt_per_km), 2) AS average_density_adt_per_km
        FROM traffic_forecasts
        GROUP BY year

views.name: v_overload_link_risk
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_overload_link_risk AS
        SELECT
            link_id,
            road_no,
            link_name,
            road_class,
            surface_type,
            region,
            length_km,
            overload_record_count,
            overload_count,
            ROUND(overload_rate_percent, 3) AS overload_rate_percent,
            ROUND(overload_risk_score, 3) AS overload_risk_score,
            overload_band
        FROM road_links
        WHERE overload_record_count > 0
        ORDER BY overload_risk_score DESC, overload_count DESC

            axle_group_overloaded_records,
            ROUND(overload_rate_percent, 3) AS overload_rate_percent,
            ROUND(chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS chargeable_overload_tonnes,
            ROUND(max_chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS max_chargeable_overload_tonnes
        FROM overload_monthly_summary
        ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, overloaded_records DESC

views.name: v_overload_station_risk
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_overload_station_risk AS
        SELECT
            station_key,
            station_code,
            station_name,
            station_type,
            link_id,
            link_name,
            road_class,
            longitude,
            latitude,
            records,
            overloaded_records,
            ROUND(overload_rate_percent, 3) AS overload_rate_percent,
            ROUND(overload_risk_score, 3) AS overload_risk_score,
            overload_band,
            ROUND(chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS chargeable_overload_tonnes,
            ROUND(max_chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS max_chargeable_overload_tonnes
        FROM weighbridge_stations
        ORDER BY overload_risk_score DESC, overloaded_records DESC

views.name: v_overload_vehicle_config_risk
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_overload_vehicle_config_risk AS
        SELECT
            vehicle_config,
            records,
            overloaded_records,
            gross_overloaded_records,
            axle_group_overloaded_records,
            ROUND(overload_rate_percent, 3) AS overload_rate_percent,
            ROUND(chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS chargeable_overload_tonnes,
            ROUND(max_chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS max_chargeable_overload_tonnes
        FROM overload_vehicle_config_summary
        ORDER BY overloaded_records DESC, overload_rate_percent DESC

views.name: v_overload_yearly_trend
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_overload_yearly_trend AS
        SELECT
            year,
            records,
            overloaded_records,
            ROUND(overload_rate_percent, 3) AS overload_rate_percent,
            ROUND(chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS chargeable_overload_tonnes,
            ROUND(max_chargeable_overload_kg / 1000.0, 3) AS max_chargeable_overload_tonnes
        FROM overload_yearly_summary
        ORDER BY year

views.name: v_region_yearly_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_region_yearly_summary AS
        SELECT
            r.region,
            f.year,
            COUNT(*) AS link_count,
            ROUND(SUM(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS total_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS average_adt,
            ROUND(SUM(r.length_km), 2) AS length_km
        FROM road_links r
        JOIN traffic_forecasts f ON f.link_id = r.link_id
        GROUP BY r.region, f.year

views.name: v_source_inventory_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_source_inventory_summary AS
        SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS file_count, ROUND(SUM(size_mb), 3) AS size_mb
        FROM source_files
        GROUP BY category
        ORDER BY file_count DESC

views.name: v_station_group_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_station_group_summary AS
        SELECT
            station_group,
            station_type,
            status,
            COUNT(*) AS station_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS region_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT link_id) AS linked_road_sections
        FROM stations
        GROUP BY station_group, station_type, status
        ORDER BY station_count DESC

views.name: v_surface_yearly_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_surface_yearly_summary AS
        SELECT
            r.surface_type,
            f.year,
            COUNT(*) AS link_count,
            ROUND(SUM(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS total_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(f.forecast_adt), 2) AS average_adt,
            ROUND(SUM(r.length_km), 2) AS length_km
        FROM road_links r
        JOIN traffic_forecasts f ON f.link_id = r.link_id
        GROUP BY r.surface_type, f.year

views.name: v_tis_observed_year_summary
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_tis_observed_year_summary AS
        SELECT
            observation_year,
            source_table,
            COUNT(*) AS observation_rows,
            COUNT(DISTINCT link_id) AS linked_road_sections,
            COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS stations,
            ROUND(AVG(observed_aadt), 2) AS average_observed_aadt,
            ROUND(MAX(observed_aadt), 2) AS peak_observed_aadt,
            ROUND(SUM(observed_aadt), 2) AS total_observed_aadt
        FROM tis_observations
        WHERE observed_aadt > 0
        GROUP BY observation_year, source_table
        ORDER BY observation_year, source_table

views.name: v_top_corridors_forecast_end
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_top_corridors_forecast_end AS
        SELECT
            r.link_id,
            r.road_no,
            r.link_name,
            r.region,
            r.road_class,
            r.surface_type,
            r.length_km,
            f.year AS forecast_year,
            ROUND(f.forecast_adt, 2) AS forecast_adt,
            ROUND(f.density_adt_per_km, 2) AS density_adt_per_km,
            COALESCE(m.risk_score, 0) AS ml_risk_score,
            COALESCE(m.heavy_vehicle_adt, 0) AS heavy_vehicle_adt,
            r.overload_record_count,
            r.overload_count,
            r.overload_rate_percent,
            r.overload_risk_score,
            r.overload_band,
            r.annual_traffic_file_count,
            r.annual_od_file_count,
            r.annual_data_score,
            r.traffic_inconsistency_count
        FROM road_links r
        JOIN traffic_forecasts f ON f.link_id = r.link_id
        LEFT JOIN ml_risk_corridors m ON m.link_id = r.link_id
        WHERE f.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM traffic_forecasts)
        ORDER BY f.forecast_adt DESC

views.name: v_traffic_flow_inconsistencies
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_traffic_flow_inconsistencies AS
        SELECT
            inconsistency_id,
            link_id,
            link_name,
            region,
            road_class,
            surface,
            from_year,
            to_year,
            previous_adt,
            current_adt,
            drop_percent,
            explanation,
            status
        FROM traffic_flow_inconsistencies
        ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'corrected' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, drop_percent DESC

views.name: v_vehicle_class_totals
views.ddl:
CREATE VIEW v_vehicle_class_totals AS
        SELECT
            v.vehicle_class,
            o.class_rank,
            o.color,
            COUNT(DISTINCT v.link_id) AS link_count,
            ROUND(SUM(v.adt_reference), 2) AS total_reference_adt,
            ROUND(AVG(v.adt_reference), 2) AS average_reference_adt,
            e.esa_factor
        FROM vehicle_classes v
        LEFT JOIN vehicle_class_order o ON o.vehicle_class = v.vehicle_class
        LEFT JOIN esa_factors e ON e.vehicle_class = v.vehicle_class
        GROUP BY v.vehicle_class, o.class_rank, o.color, e.esa_factor
        ORDER BY o.class_rank
